unlisted_practices: Automated open-source workflow for constructing continuous, age-stratified laboratory reference intervals with multiple outlier removal methods
Internal time-series validation of reference intervals against the CLSI EP28-A3c threshold
Packaging the workflow as LLM agent skills so laboratories can use it without programming expertise

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an automated, LLM-agent-based workflow to construct clinical laboratory reference intervals from retrospective real-world data, but does not test a deployment practice or safeguard.
